siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Ralf Berendsen
siblings.summary: Six day-trip shapes around the 2-star Ralf Berendsen at Domaine La Butte aux Bois — Maastricht, Hoge Kempen, Bokrijk+Genk, Tongeren, Hasselt, Valkenburg — with hours, 2026 ticket prices and drive times.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Ralf Berendsen
siblings.summary: Two real walking-distance options for a Ralf Berendsen Saturday dinner — stay inside La Butte aux Bois (0 m, restaurant on-site) or walk 1.1 km from Hotel Admiraal.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Ralf Berendsen
siblings.summary: Eleven character stays within a 20-minute taxi of the 2-star Ralf Berendsen, from the on-site Relais & Châteaux to a Gothic-monastery design hotel and a moated Lanaken kasteel.
